#dim tSC As %Status=$$$OK $$$TRACE("Inside Method ProcessHttpsRequest")
$$$TRACE("Access Token: "_pRequest.accessToken)

set msgType = pRequest.msgType

Set pResponse=##class(EnsLib.HTTP.GenericMessage).%New()
Set httprequest=##class(%Net.HttpRequest).%New() set httprequest.Timeout=..Adapter.ResponseTimeout Set httprequest.ContentType="application/json" Set httprequest.SSLConfiguration = ..Adapter.SSLConfig if (msgType="A04"){ set url = ..Adapter.URL_"/encounter/create" }else{ set url = ..Adapter.URL_"/encounter/callOverture" } Set httprequest.Location = url $$$TRACE("Location: "_httprequest.Location) Do httprequest.EntityBody.Write() ; do httprequest.EntityBody.CopyFrom(tStream)
set sc=##class(%SYS.OAuth2.AccessToken).AuthorizeWithAccessToken(httprequest,"header",..Adapter.SSLConfig,"PingSecurityToken",pRequest.accessToken) $$$TRACE("Token status (Add) "_sc) Set mylist = ##class(%Collection.ArrayOfObj).%New() set postStatus = httprequest.Post(url)
if $$$ISERR(postStatus) { do $system.OBJ.DisplayError() set tSC = postStatus } else { set tHttpResponse=httprequest.HttpResponse $$$TRACE("StatusLine: "_tHttpResponse.StatusLine) set stream = tHttpResponse.Data set outStr = "" While 'stream.AtEnd { set outStr = outStr _ stream.ReadLine(,.sc,.eol) $$$TRACE( outStr) } set statusLine = tHttpResponse.StatusLine set statusCode = "" set statusDesc = "" if (statusLine'=""){ set statusCode=$piece(statusLine," ",2) set statusDesc=$piece(statusLine," ",3) } $$$TRACE(" *** STatusCode:::: "_statusCode) do pResponse.StreamSet(stream) $$$TRACE(" *** STream::: "_stream) do pResponse.Attributes.SetAt(statusCode,"StatusCode") do pResponse.Attributes.SetAt(statusDesc,"StatusDesc")
}
quit tSC
